description.value: The James Bay Inn Pub is a long-established neighbourhood pub tucked inside the historic James Bay Inn hotel, just a short ride from Victoria's Inner Harbour. It offers a broad menu of pub classics, comfort food, local BC wines, craft beers, and weekend brunch, with a welcoming atmosphere that draws both locals and visitors. For a touring cyclist finishing a day on the Galloping Goose or Lochside trails, it sits in a convenient and walkable part of downtown Victoria.

Takeout is confirmed by the website navigation ('Delivery Take Out') and a blog post referencing an online pick-up menu; a brunch Veggie Skillet confirms at least one vegetarian option; OSM tags internet_access=wlan but the website does not mention Wi-Fi, so that amenity is left null per instructions.
